source_population: Eight analyzed older cadaveric left hips; intact aggregate periarticular restraint, not capsule-only tissue isolation

parameter_evidence.mid_slack: Published Figure5 neutral regression y=-0.21*flexion_degrees+5.7; F0 intercept is a regression estimate, not an individual specimen zero.
parameter_evidence.slack_width: Figure4 neutral F0 mean; manual plot read rounded to0.5deg.
parameter_evidence.slack_to_5Nm: Figure6 left neutral F0 pooled rotation-direction mean; manual plot read rounded to0.5deg.
parameter_evidence.stiffness: Figure6 right neutral F0 pooled rotation-direction mean; manual plot read rounded to0.01Nm/deg.

plot_reading.method: Manual pixel selections from unmodified PDF pages rendered by pdftoppm -scale-to1800; approximate, not raw torque-angle samples

uncertainty.scope: CIs describe published means, not a95% individual prediction interval; correlations and regression-intercept uncertainty unavailable. No joint-confidence torque envelope claimed.

law.stretch: x=max(0,abs(theta-center)-slack_width/2), all angles converted to radians
law.domain: Flexion=0,adduction=0;0<=x<=toe,aggregate resistance<=5Nm. All other poses/rotation beyond endpoint rejected.
assumptions: Power toe is an engineering interpolation constrained by endpoint torque and tangent; its interior is not independently validated.
Zero torque/stiffness at slack onset approximates the experimental0.03Nm/deg threshold; transition torque and hysteresis were not digitized.
Equal external/internal toe laws use the pooled Figure6 means; centered asymmetry follows Figure5, not a claim of directional symmetry in specimens.
No damping coefficient or multi-DOF cross-coupling is identified; no generic spring activates at the existing40deg software ROM.
